time_semantics.validation: PASS for 31 retained rows against source global survey-date summary; one corrupted/anomalous source timestamp quarantined without repair

interpretation: A second independent 2016 Mobile Bay vertical-profile archive again shows a strong inverse relationship between vertical salinity stratification and bottom oxygen state. All three <20% saturation profiles occurred on the most oxygen-stressed survey date, but the sample is very small. This corroborates stratification as an oxygen-loading state marker; it does not establish a Jubilee trigger or event probability.
guardrails: Source dissolved oxygen is percent saturation, not mg/L; no concentration threshold was inferred.
One anomalous time row was quarantined rather than repaired or relabeled.
Low-saturation profiles are physical-state observations, not Jubilee events.
No production feature, weight, threshold, or alert logic changed.
